subject.title: fix(brave): resolve env secret refs for search key

question: Should Brave adopt the shared contract that an unavailable explicitly configured SecretRef must not fall back to BRAVE_API_KEY?
rationale: The implementation and existing shared tests support fail-closed behavior to prevent wrong-account authentication, but merging intentionally changes a previously reachable fallback for some existing configurations.

options.title: Accept account-safe precedence
options.body: Land this PR and treat an explicit SecretRef as authoritative, returning a missing-key result when it cannot resolve.

options.title: Preserve Brave ambient fallback
options.body: Require Brave-specific divergence so BRAVE_API_KEY remains usable after an explicit reference fails, accepting possible wrong-account routing.

recommendation.title: Accept account-safe precedence
recommendation.body: Land this PR and treat an explicit SecretRef as authoritative, returning a missing-key result when it cannot resolve.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the shared fail-closed credential contract and recent provider-owned Brave compatibility behavior.
